messages:
Rox: Noticed a couple of confusing bits in the compact compare flow during the demo. putting them here so we can triage. Rox: 1) Tooltip hover delay is 600ms which is fine on desktop, but on mobile long-press it's awkward. users expect immediate info for badges. Rox: 2) Legend is hidden in the overflow menu, people didn't find it. we should surface a micro-help in the header. Priya: Re: hover delay 12 we need to respect prefers-reduced-motion + reduce hover delay for touch. also show tooltip on focus. Priya: For mobile we should make the badge tappable to open a small popover rather than rely on hover. Evan: Legend in header is good. Suggest a compact help icon that opens a tiny popover with: tier name, sample metric, and a one-line take: e.g. "Latency-first 12 P95 < 50ms (reference harness). Not a cost indicator." Jared: On pin semantics: users still ask whether pinning is persistent account-wide. Our tooltip says "Pin to compare" but some people gloss it. Can we show a short ephemeral banner when a pin is added: "Pinned for this compare session" with a learn-more link? DesignOps: I'll mock a header help popover + ephemeral banner. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzpop/mock-compare-help (WIP). I'll include an accordion in the popover for metric details. Rox: Accessibility: screen-reader users reported that tooltip text isn't announced when using keyboard focus. Need aria-describedby when tooltip is visible and aria-live for ephemeral banners. Priya: For implementation: badge should always include aria-label e.g. `aria-label="Performance: latency-first; P95 under 50ms"`. On focus, show the popover and set `aria-describedby` to the popover id. Evan: For the hover/tap behavior: polyfill idea: on touch start open popover immediately; on touch end if tapped outside close it. For keyboard, open on focus and close on blur or Esc. Jared: Analytics: track `catalog.help.popover_opened` with { view: 'compare', density: 'compact', trigger: 'hover|tap|keyboard' } as strings. track `catalog.pin.session_banner_shown` too. DesignOps: Microcopy draft for popover: Title: "Performance tiers" Body: "Latency-first 12 P95 < 50ms on our reference harness. Balanced 12 P95 50150ms. Throughput-first 12 optimized for requests-per-second. These are performance signals, not cost guarantees." Link: "Learn how we measure" -> small modal with unit examples (ms, rps, $/1k tokens). Priya: Code snippet for badge (rough): ``` openPopover()} onMouseEnter={() => openPopover(delayForMotion())} onTouchStart={() => openPopover(0)} /> ``` Priya: And for pin banner: ```
Pinned for this compare session.
``` a11y-bot: Quick checklist: 1) All badges must include aria-label and be operable by keyboard/touch. 2) Popovers must set aria-describedby when open and trap focus if modal. 3) Ephemeral banners should use role=status and be announced. 4) Respect prefers-reduced-motion for hover delays and animations. 5) Track help + pin events as suggested. Rox: Next steps: DesignOps to drop mock and copy; Priya to prototype accessible popover behaviour; Evan to add analytics hooks; Jared to write a short note for docs & support clarifying pin scope. Priya: I'll open a small PR with the aria-label prop on Badge + popover wiring. keeping it unflagged but request review from a11y before merge. Evan: I'll coordinate the event schema with analytics infra, sending strings only. Rox: Thanks all 12 aim for a quick staging smoke test after PRs land.
